sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao Portrait

Ricky Hsiao, the Taiwanese pop and C-pop artist also known as 蕭煌奇, stands against a neutral gray background wearing a mustard-yellow blazer layered over pastel shirts. His slicked-back hair and oval sunglasses emphasize a modern, stylish look that aligns with his soulful and emotionally resonant music.

Known for hits like "Mo Ban Che" and "He Ping Fen Shou," Ricky blends traditional and contemporary sounds. His 2022 album "Shuo Gu Shi De Ge" features both upbeat tracks and poignant ballads. Collaborations with Rachel Liang, A-Lin, EggPlantEgg, and others have broadened his appeal in Taiwan and beyond.

sources.description:
蕭煌奇的輕鬆時刻

Taiwanese singer-songwriter 蕭煌奇 leans against a wooden window frame, dressed in a beige jacket and dark sunglasses. The decorative wrought-iron balcony railing and soft daylight create a warm, intimate atmosphere. His relaxed posture and casual attire convey a sense of ease and confidence.

Known for hits like “你是我的生命” and “沒那麼簡單,” 蕭煌奇’s career spans competition wins, band formations, and genre explorations from rock covers to R&B and rap. This portrait captures the artist in a quiet moment, reflecting the calm behind his vibrant musical journey.

sources.title: 今天不開玩笑！蕭煌奇曬婚戒曝結婚喜訊 | 娛樂 | Newtalk新聞
sources.description:
蕭煌奇時尚宣傳照

金曲歌王蕭煌奇身著綠色西裝與黃色襯衫，配戴墨鏡，優雅地坐在棕色皮椅上，背景為暖色調。這張照片展現了他成熟穩重的個人風格，並可能與他近日在社群平台曬婚戒、宣布結婚喜訊的動態相關。

蕭煌奇在社群平台無預警分享與女友的婚戒，幽默表示「今天沒有要跟你開玩笑、我結婚了」。兩人透過朋友介紹交往一年，選在無工作行程的日子完婚。消息曝光後，網友紛紛湧入祝福，恭賀這位出道25年的歌王新婚快樂。

sources.description:
蕭煌奇BRAVO演唱會宣傳照

蕭煌奇以黑色西裝外套搭配白色T恤，並戴上紅色細框太陽眼鏡，展現時尚與自信的舞台魅力。淺灰色背景簡潔，將焦點集中在藝人的造型與神情上。

這張照片用於宣傳他將於2026年9月18日及19日在台北小巨蛋舉辦的「BRAVO」演唱會。門票於端午連假週末開賣即告完售，主辦方於6月22日宣布加開9月18日一場。蕭煌奇對於票房成績感到感動，並自信體力充沛，計畫在演唱會上演唱經典曲目、開放點歌並邀請好友助陣，與歌迷共度難忘夜晚。

Xiao Huangqi Reveals His Eyes

Taiwanese singer Xiao Huangqi posted a close-up portrait without his signature sunglasses to address rumors that he was faking blindness. In the photo, he wears a beige suit over a floral shirt and holds his sunglasses in both hands, looking calmly into the camera. His eyes display a silvery sheen that resembles white contact lenses, a result of his congenital cataracts.

sources.description:
Ricky Hsiao’s “No Worries” Album Cover

Ricky Hsiao’s 2024 album “No Worries” (沒事的) presents a minimalist portrait of the singer with his eyes closed, framed by two hands pressing gently on his cheeks. The dark backdrop highlights the teal typography spelling out “RICKY HSIAO” at the top and “NO WORRIES” at the bottom, while the Chinese characters 蕭煌奇 and 沒事的 appear on either side.

Released on Apple Music, the album comprises 10 tracks totaling 42 minutes. The bilingual title and serene imagery reflect the album’s message of reassurance and calm, inviting listeners to embrace a worry-free mindset.
